name: SmokeCompositeA
title: Smoke composite component A
description: PAT-259 component A: adults (>= 18) in the denominator, >= 40 in the numerator → 2 / 4 = 50 %.
cqlContent:
library SmokeCompositeA version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<DateTime>

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 18

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"

define "Numerator":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 40
